prompts.task:
$otel-instrument

Work in ./service. Copy eval/inputs/otel-audit.json to .observe/otel-audit.json and select OTEL-001,OTEL-002,OTEL-003 through the bundled selection flow. Improve detection of enqueue failures, delayed or stuck fulfillment work, and worker failures. Preserve the Docker Compose runtime.

judge_inputs: Inspect ./service for resulting source, configuration, tests, and .observe reports.
Read ./last_message.md for the agent final response.
rubric:
Rule: Preserves the Docker Compose runtime and instruments both the FastAPI process and Celery worker with distinct configurable service identities, OTLP export, propagation, and FastAPI/Celery/Redis auto-instrumentation without duplicate SDK initialization.
Example: Keep API and worker identities distinct under the existing Compose launch.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: Duplicate providers or an uninstrumented worker process.

Rule: Adds detector-ready app-owned metrics for order enqueue outcome/failure and fulfillment task outcome/failure, plus an accurately measured queue-delay, task-age, duration, last-success, or pending-work signal that can reveal stuck work before users manually inspect an order.
Example: Record enqueue/task outcomes and one measured stuck-work indicator.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: A fabricated queue-age or pending-work measurement.

Rule: Handles send_task and worker exception paths explicitly and keeps trace/error status useful; it does not report a successful enqueue or task completion when the underlying operation failed.
Example: A failed send_task or task body produces a failure outcome.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: Success telemetry after the underlying operation failed.

Rule: Keeps metric attributes bounded to workflow, operation, outcome, or reason family and never uses order ID, product, request/session ID, raw exception message, or payload content as metric dimensions.
Example: Use operation and outcome families instead of order or payload values.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: An order ID, session, exception message or payload as a dimension.

Rule: Owner-maps unavailable Redis queue depth, Celery fleet health, or broker/platform metrics instead of emitting placeholders or claiming complete coverage from app-local state.
Example: Identify broker-owned queue depth as a deployment prerequisite.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: A synthetic fleet-health value presented as app-owned coverage.

Rule: Adds focused tests for successful and failed enqueue/task telemetry paths and runs the existing Python test/import checks or records a concrete blocker with command evidence.
Example: Execute success/failure tests or retain the exact failed setup command.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: A claimed test pass without execution or a concrete blocker.

Rule: Writes proof-aware instrumentation and verification handoff material that names exact signals, distinguishes MTTD-improving detector inputs from localization-only telemetry, and lists remaining broker or deployment prerequisites.
Example: Report exact detector inputs and remaining broker prerequisites.
Evidence: Inspect the selected application path, actual changes, commands and bound reports for this rule. Require execution only where the rule calls for it; keep unselected branches outside its scope.
Insufficient evidence: Local spans alone presented as complete early-detection coverage.
